mechanism: Both drugs increase dopaminergic and noradrenergic activity in the CNS; methylphenidate inhibits monoamine reuptake while memantine antagonizes NMDA receptors, potentially leading to excessive CNS stimulation.
action: Monitor for signs of excessive stimulation (agitation, insomnia, tremor, tachycardia); consider dose adjustment or increased monitoring frequency; use combination judiciously in patients with cardiac arrhythmias or seizure history.
